accuracyReview.method: Developer spot-check against original official excerpts and Notebook displayed citations, not an independent expert evaluation
accuracyReview.majorAnswers: All seven answered the main question consistently with the available documents, including declining unknown future budget and municipal availability
accuracyReview.notebookStrength: Sentence-level citation markers and source excerpts are easy to inspect; fee quotation was opened and checked
notebookIssues: The cleaning exception was presented inside quotation marks as a reorganized paraphrase rather than a verbatim contiguous quote.

The municipal-availability answer generalizes the guideline into saying that vacancy is predetermined by municipalities. The guideline supports defining service scope/rules/fees, not that claim about live vacancy.
ruriIssues: Earlier comparison found omitted citation IDs for supplementary details, despite those details being in retrieved text.

limitations: Notebook internal model was not shown or pinned; this compares product configurations, not the same LLM or retrieval algorithm.
Notebook timing measures UI submission to completed copy control; Ruri timing measures HTTP completion. No first-token comparison was made.
First Notebook question has only a 35.5-second upper bound from exploratory inspection and is excluded from timing medians.
Municipal availability uses an immediate deterministic local guard in the app and is excluded from both matched timing sets.
Notebook used a continuous seven-turn conversation; the app resets history between unrelated topics in the saved benchmark.
Ruri full seven-question results are from the earlier run; two current repeated requests are separately reported.
Small sample; no statistical latency or universal accuracy guarantee.
